The question asks for the key signature in which the Billboard Hot 100's number-one song on June 8, 2002 was performed. The Predicted Answer states the song ("Foolish" by Ashanti) and specifies the key as C-sharp minor (C♯ minor), with a key signature of four sharps. The Ground Truth Answer is "C major."
